## Reading materials and tools

-   The online course book, [*Foundational Computational Tools for Bioengineers*](book/index.html), is the primary reading. The table below lists the chapters to read for each week; the same links appear on the [Lectures](Lectures.qmd) page and on the first slide of every lecture.

### *Additional resources*

-   [Bioinformatics Data Skills](https://vincebuffalo.com/book/). 2015. Vince Buffalo. O'Reilly.
-   See the [Resources](Resources.qmd) page for the course book, cheat sheets, and more.

### *Tools*

-   You will be working on your own laptop computer
-   A Unix shell: Terminal on macOS/Linux, or WSL/Ubuntu on Windows (see the [Software](Software.qmd) page)
-   Latest versions of [R](https://www.r-project.org) and [Python](https://www.python.org)
-   An editor/IDE: [VS Code](https://code.visualstudio.com) or [Positron](https://positron.posit.co) (RStudio is fine too)
-   [Quarto](https://quarto.org) with TinyTeX for rendering documents and LaTeX math
-   Git installed and a GitHub account
-   An `ssh` client for connecting to the UO computing cluster (Talapas) - built into every shell above

## Course schedule

Class meets Mondays from 4:00 to 5:00 PM in KC2 213, September 28 - November 30, 2026. A kick-off bootcamp will be held Thursday, September 24 from 9:00 AM to 1:00 PM in the KC2 Seminar Room.
